verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss documents a REST API that covers many UI concepts: people search by smart list and custom fields, file attachments, text-message records, triggering automations, applying action plans, and webhooks. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows UI parity, and several UI features have no API counterpart in the pack. Missing for 10: any stated UI-parity commitment, API coverage of native calling/texting/emailing, calendar/email sync, lead-distribution rule configuration, and reporting, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Follow Up Boss provides a simple [REST API](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Representational_state_transfer) that allows developers to integrate their applications quickly.
Search for people that match a smart list with given ID.
Manually trigger an Automation for a specified Person.
Apply an Action Plan to a person.
Attach a file to a person.
